images.filename: 18PounderInMudLangemarckThirdYpres16Oct1917.jpg
images.caption:
IWM caption : "THE THIRD BATTLE OF YPRES. Battle of Poelcappelle: Manhandling an 18-pounder field gun through the mud near Langemarck, 16 October 1917."

Comment : The Battle of Poelcappelle was fought on 9th October. If the date of 16th October is correct, this may in fact show a gun being brought up for the Second Battle of Passchendaele which began on 26th October.
images.alt:
IWM caption : "THE THIRD BATTLE OF YPRES. Battle of Poelcappelle: Manhandling an 18-pounder field gun through the mud near Langemarck, 16 October 1917."

images.filename: 9.2-inch howitzer at Wieltje Sep 1917 IWM Q 3017.jpg
images.caption:
IWM caption : THE BATTLE OF PASSCHENDAELE, JULY-NOVEMBER 1917. A 9.2 inch howitzer on a travelling carriage being moved forward by motor tractor. The camouflaged gun-pit and light railway for ammunition supply are seen, also another 9.2 inch ready on travelling carriages for moving. Royal Garrison Artillery (R.G.A.), Wieltje, 5th September 1917.
